_note: Content for the Toolbox on the home page: the steps of a data project and the skills used at each one. 'focus' says which role a step matters for (slugs from projects.json). 'learning': true marks a skill you are still learning. For every skill the page works out, from projects.json, how many of your projects use it (shown as a number, and as the dot: solid = used in 3 or more, ring = used in 1 or 2, dashed = learning). 'projects' and 'certs' are the proof shown under a step: project ids, and words that appear in certificate titles. If 'projects' has fewer than 3, the page fills the rest with projects that use the step's skills.
lead: Not a pile of logos. These are the skills I use at each step of turning data into a decision, and where you can see them.

stages.title: Ask the right question
stages.text: Before any code, I pin down the decision the numbers should support and how success will be measured.
stages.how: A clear question and a few agreed metrics save more time than any clever model.

stages.title: Get the data
stages.text: Pull data out of databases and APIs, and design the tables it lives in so it stays easy to use.
stages.how: Most of the work is knowing where the data is hiding and how the pieces fit together.

stages.title: Make it trustworthy
stages.text: Clean, join and check the data so the numbers can be believed.
stages.how: I look for gaps, duplicates and odd values before anything else.

stages.title: Find the answer
stages.text: Explore patterns, test ideas and build models that explain what is going on, not just what will happen.
stages.how: I would rather hand you a model you understand than one that scores a point higher.

stages.title: Show it clearly
stages.text: Turn the findings into dashboards and charts that let a team see what is happening at a glance.
stages.how: If someone needs me to explain a chart, the chart is not finished.

stages.title: Keep it running
stages.text: Schedule, containerise and deploy the work so it keeps running without me pressing a button.
stages.how: Scheduled, checked and logged beats manual every time.

stages.title: Let AI do the legwork
stages.text: Build agents that call tools, look things up in documents and show the steps they took.
stages.how: I am still learning this one, so I build small, test often and keep humans in the loop.
